課程綱要.開課單位: 應用地質研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程目標: To teach basic numerical methods required for applied geology. Give students experience in understanding the properties of different numerical methods so as to be able to choose appropriate methods and interpret the results for problems that they might encounter. Students will implement and study the numerical methods using FORTRAN language. Emphasis is given to the applications of the various types of numerical methods.
課程綱要.授課內容:
1.非線性代數方程式求解
2.聯立代數方程式求解
3.數值積分方法
4.常微分方程之有限差分法
5.偏微分方程之有限差分法
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Gerald, C.F., P.O. Wheatley, P. O.,2004, Applied Numerical Analysis, Seventh Edition, Pearson Education, Inc., Boston.
課程綱要.評量配分比重: 作業 40％ 期中考 30％ 期末考 30％

課程綱要.開課單位: 應用地質研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程名稱(中文): 活動大地構造暨地震地質
課程綱要.課程目標: Acquire the current knowledge on active fault behavior, master the concepts and techniques of active fault investigations from the earthquake cycle timescale to the timescale of 10-100-ka cumulative deformation, and learn how these findings apply to seismic hazard assessment. Audience: Graduate students and professionals from the fields of tectonics, structural geology, Quaternary geology, seismology, hazard assessment or civil engineering…
課程綱要.授課內容:
Lecture and discussion class on the following topics:
Mechanics, rheology, friction / Earthquake cycle, fault slip budget, seismicity, earthquake source / Geodetic methods / Faults and stress field / Tectonic geomorphology and fault geometries in extensional, compressional, strike-slip, and oblique settings / Earthquake ruptures, earthquake geology, paleoseismology / Quaternary geochronology / Active fault-related folding / Subsurface imaging of active faults / Seismic hazard and earthquake-induced hazards / Applications of earthquake geology for engineering geology and seismic hazard assessment.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: - The Mechanics of Earthquakes and Faulting, by C. H. Scholz - Tectonic Geomorphology, by D. W. Burbank and R. S. Anderson - Paleoseismology by J. P. McCalpin (2009) - and other resources from scientific articles
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Oral presentation (50％) + Classroom performance and assignments (50％)
課程綱要.課程領域: 基礎學科 、 地質災害

課程名稱(英文): Special Topics on stochastic groundwater modeling
備註: [不開放初選]

課程綱要.開課單位: 應用地質研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Special Topics on stochastic groundwater modeling
課程綱要.課程目標: Hydrological, geophysical, and geochemical properties and processes of geological media are known to vary spatially and temporally at a multiplicity of scales and dimensions. In most realistic situations, scales of observations are often inconsistent with the scale of the tools for interpretation; scales of properties estimated from hydro/geophysical tests rarely agree with others; and modeled grid scales are frequently incoherent with the measurement scales. The arising issues are: how can we incorporate the estimations on different scales and provide appropriate strategies to better describe the distributions of hydrogeological properties in geological media? The purpose of this course is to provide knowledge of subsurface hydrology to quantitatively tackle issues relating to scales and spatial/temporal variability of hydrogeological properties in geological media.
課程綱要.授課內容:
1. Review of techniques for exploratory data analysis
2. Review of spatial data analysis and variogram fitting
3. Review of regressions and geostatistical interpolations
4. Geostatistical simulations
5. Stochastic modeling and uncertainty analysis
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Kitanidis P.K. (1997), Introduction to Geostatistics – Applications in Hydrogeology, Cambridge University Press, Inc. Gelhar, Lynn W.(1993), Stochastic Subsurface Hydrology, Prentice-Hall, Inc. Zhang, D.(2001) Stochastic Methods for Flow in Porous Media: Coping with Uncertainties, Academic Press. Yeh, T.C., Khaleel R., Carroll, K.C. (2015). Flow through Heterogeneous Geologic Media. Cambridge University Press.
課程綱要.授課方式: 講授 研討 實習/實驗 個別指導
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Homework/mini projects 60% Mid term 20% Final exam 20%
